examples.japanese: 問題が起これば、学校だけで何とかしよう、外にはもらすまい。
examples.body_text:
問題が起これば、学校だけで何とかしよう、外にはもらすまい。 

		If some trouble crops up, sort it out somehow or other in school - 
		don't let it 
		leak outside.
examples.body_html:
問題が起これば、学校だけで何とかしよう、外にはもらすまい。 
If some trouble crops up, sort it out somehow or other in school - don't let it leak outside.

examples.japanese: 一兵たりとも逃すまいぞ！（Archaic)
examples.body_text:
一兵たりとも逃すまいぞ！（Archaic) 

Don't 
		even let a single enemy soldier escape!
examples.body_html:
一兵たりとも逃すまいぞ！（Archaic) 
Don't even let a single enemy soldier escape!

examples.japanese: あいつはそこまではやるまい。
examples.body_text:
あいつはそこまではやるまい。 

		I 
		don't think 
		he would dare go that far.
examples.body_html:
あいつはそこまではやるまい。 
I don't think he would dare go that far.

まい is kinda like ないだろう, or ないとおもう I guess.

Also its pretty formal and not used much in conversation nowadays.

comments.text:

ex#, you can repalce with 〜してはならない

ex#, 〜しないつもりだ

ex#, 〜ないと思う
